@odata.context.description: The information about Karbon controllers generating this response.

@odata.type.description: The information about Karbon Objects generating this response.

ContactKey.description: A Karbon-generated value that is used to identify the Contact

FirstName.description: The first name of the Contact

MiddleName.description: The middle name of the Contact

LastName.description: The last name of the Contact

PreferredName.description: The preferred name of the Contact

Salutation.description: The title to address the Contact

ClientOwner.description: The team member in your firm who looks after client relationship or is responsible for the vast majority of the work of the Contact. You can only use the UserKey or the email address of an existing team member.

ClientManager.description: The team member in your firm who manages the work for Contact. You can only use the UserKey or the email address of an existing team member.

ContactType.description: The Contact Type for this Contact. You can only use existing Contact Types, these are available from the TenantSettings endpoint.

UserDefinedIdentifier.description: A unique key that you can use to identify this Contact.

RestrictionLevel.description:
The privacy level for this Client Group.
  • Public Client Groups can be managed by anyone in the firm
  • Private Client Groups can only be managed by the [Client Team](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/articles/1524707-create-a-client-team). Basic details (name of the Contacts and the Work Items) related to such Client Groups are visible to anyone in the firm.
  • Hidden Client Groups are only be visible to and managed by the [Client Team](https://help.karbonhq.com/en/articles/1524707-create-a-client-team).

AvatarUrl.description: The URL to the Contact's avatar

LastModifiedDateTime.description: The date and time at which this Contact was last modified.

Text.description: Free-form text that can be used to add more information about the Client Group

BusinessCardRequest.description: A business card associated with a contact or organization

BusinessCardKey.description: A Karbon-generated unique identifier for the Business Card

EntityType.description: The type of entity this Business Card belongs to.

EntityKey.description: A Karbon-generated key to indicate the entity (Contact, Organization, or ClientGroup) this Business Card belongs to.

IsPrimaryCard.description: Set to true, if this business card is also the primary business card for this entity.

OrganizationKey.description: Used on the Business Card for a Contact to specify the Organization that the Contact is related to. Will always be null for an Organization business card.

WebSites.description: The websites associated with this Business card.

EmailAddresses.description: The email addresses associated with this Business card.

RoleOrTitle.description: The business role or title of the contact this Business Cards belongs to

FacebookLink.description: The URL to the entity's Facebook profile

LinkedInLink.description: The URL to the entity's LinkedIn profile

TwitterLink.description: The URL to the entity's Twitter profile

SkypeLink.description: The URL to the entity's Skype profile

Label.description: The tag to indicate the type of Address

Number.description: The phone number of the entity

Label.description: The tag to indicate the type of phone number

ClientAccess.description: A list of Organizations and People that the contact has been granted access to view in Karbon for Clients

ClientKey.description: The unique key of the Client

ClientType.description: Whether the Client is an Organization or a Person

AccessLevel.description: The level of access this contact has when viewing the specified client in Karbon for Clients

ClientTeam.description: The Client Team associated with a contact or organization

MemberKey.description: The unique key of the user or team assigned to the client team role

MemberType.description: The type of member assigned to the client team, can be either User or Team

RoleType.description: The specific role the user or team is assigned to, can be null if a member of the client team without a specific role

DetailsOfAccounting.description: The details specific to the Accounting firm related to this entity

ContactPermaKey.description: A Karbon-generated key that is used to identify the Contact (if a person).

OrganizationPermaKey.description: A Karbon-generated key that is used to identify the Contact (if a business or an organization).

BirthDate.description: The day at which the contact (if a person) was born.

DeathDate.description: The day at which the contact (if a person) died.

Salutation.description: The title of the contact (if a person)

Sex.description: The gender of the contact (if a person)

FinancialYearEndDay.description: The day of month in which the fiscal year ends for the contact

FinancialYearEndMonth.description: The month in which the fiscal year ends for the contact. Note that this is a 0 index value, so January is 0 and December is 11

IncorporationDate.description: The date at which the contact (if a business or an organization) was incorporated.

IncorporationState.description: The state in which the contact (if a business or an organization) was incorporated.

LegalName.description: The legal name of the contact

LineOfBusiness.description: The industry this contact is associated with.

EntityType.description: The entity type of the contact (if a business or an organization)

TaxCountryCode.description: The code of the country where the contact pays their tax.

TradingName.description: The trading name of the contact (if a business or an organization)

AnnualRevenue.description: The total annual revenue generated by the contact

BaseCurrency.description: The 3-letter code, denoting the currency of annual revenue

GstBasis.description: The method of accounting for GST/BAS

IsVATRegistered.description: Set to true if the business or organization is registered for VAT

OrganizationValuation.description: The present value of the company

PaysTax.description: Set to true, if the contact has to pay tax

RevenueModel.description: The revenue model of the business or organization

Sells.description: The item that is primarily supplied by the company

Bank.description: A user definable list of banks the client uses

Payroll.description: A user definable list of payroll services the client uses

BillPay.description: A user definable list of bill payment services the client uses

Benefits.description: A user definable list of benefits services the client uses

Revenue.description: A user definable list of revenue management services the client uses

Expenses.description: A user definable list of expense management services the client uses

FileManagement.description: A user definable list of file management services the client uses

Accounting.description: A user definable list of accounting tools and services the client uses

RegistrationNumbers.description: The registration numbers associated with the contact.

LegalFirm.description: The legal firm(s) that represent the client, these can be strings or references to Karbon organizations

Name.description: The name of the legal firm that represents the client

OrganizationKey.description: The Organization key of the Karbon organization client record

TaxProvider.description: The provider of tax services to the client, these can be strings or references to Karbon organizations

Name.description: The name of the tax provider

OrganizationKey.description: The optional Organization key of the Tax Provider client record in Karbon

Body.description: The free-form text in the note

Type.description: The section (within the accounting details) where the note resides
